service: retrieve bounded text from customer-declared public Web sources for internal journalistic research
preconditions: the customer supplies one to eight exact public HTTP or HTTPS URLs
the customer declares journalistic-source-research as the purpose
the demand fixes byte and returned-text ceilings
no credential, cookie, browser session, or customer filesystem authority is conveyed
postconditions: every acquired result binds its requested URL, final public URL, response bytes digest, extracted text digest, acquisition instant, and bounded text
individual retrieval failures are returned as typed obstruction values
the provider records its own offer, delivery, network request count, byte count, and zero-price service receipt
the provider writes no customer corpus or publication state
prohibitions: no private, loopback, link-local, or otherwise non-public network target
no paywall, authentication, robots challenge, or technical access-control circumvention
no inference of copyright license, republication rights, truth, independence, or journalistic warrant from public accessibility
no generated summary or model-authored claim
no ambient Web search or URL discovery

price.note: The current carrier uses customer-available public networking; requests and bytes remain measured even at zero monetary price.
